answer: A payout is split which means 31% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The ridge schedule is applied in sonnet and walnut publishes each instalment. A hostile operator thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3496 identities would post 2678 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
